CustomField.description: API name of the autolaunched Flow that creates/updates the Campaign Member during conversion (driven by the Create Campaign Member conversion rules and the submission's Campaign Id). Resolved and invoked by the Form_Submission_Convert__e trigger; must accept a Form_Submission_Convert__e input. Blank uses the package default.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Advanced override: API name of the Flow that creates or updates a Campaign Member on conversion. Leave blank to use the default Campaign Member conversion Flow.
CustomField.label: FlowApiName (CampaignMember)
